Our Heritage & Philosophy

The Art of Gracious Celebration in Kerala

Headquartered on Pookattiri Road, Valiyakunnu, Valanchery, Bathool Events blends timeless Malabar hospitality with contemporary luxury wedding design.

Brand Story

Born in Valanchery, Built on Trust and Craftsmanship

Established on 30 July 2023 by founders Navas CP and Sufiyan PM, Bathool Events was envisioned to elevate how families across the Malappuram district experience life’s most meaningful milestones.

We recognized that families wanted more than fragmented vendors—they sought a single, dependable creative partner capable of harmonizing grand stage decoration, atmospheric lighting, choreographed entrances, and authentic, fresh catering.

Having completed 600+ events across Valiyakunnu, Valanchery, and surrounding towns in Malappuram district, our reputation rests on punctual execution, refined design sensibility, and genuine warmth toward every guest who walks through your venue doors.
